title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A retired outlaw with a golden right eye whose Atiin name is Haseya, who is haunted by her past and cares for her sick nephew in Saddlebrush.

entities.name: Tommy
entities.description: Annie's nephew, who lives in chronic pain from a past mistake of hers and decides to leave Saddlebrush for real medicine and their people.

entities.name: Jody Carpenter
entities.description: A silver-haired widower Annie spends the night with, who later helps Tommy plan his departure.

entities.name: Bo
entities.description: A talkative young man who volunteers to help Annie hunt the rattlewurm after it venoms his sister.

entities.name: Mira
entities.description: Bo's young sister, envenomed by the rattlewurm.

entities.name: Rattlewurm
entities.description: A giant gold-plated serpent that terrorizes Saddlebrush and turns out to have a baby.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: The vicious Hellspur leader who put Tommy's life on the line because of Annie's misstep.

entities.name: Atiin
entities.description: Annie's people, whose name for her is Haseya and whose homeland treated everyone as family.

entities.name: Saddlebrush
entities.description: A small frontier town where Annie lives, threatened by the rattlewurm.

entities.name: Blue smoke
entities.description: A strong pain reliever that causes fatigue, which Tommy relies on and then gives up.

entities.name: Rattlewurm baby
entities.description: A considerably smaller rattlewurm that joins the large one at its lair.

events.summary: Annie leaves Jody Carpenter's bed in Saddlebrush, turning down his offer to stay.
events.quote: "Sorry, Jordan. I got my own bed to keep warm."

events.summary: Annie glimpses a slithering shadow near the dunes but dismisses it as paranoia.
events.quote: Annie catches movement in the distance, a slithering shadow crawling through her periphery.

events.summary: Annie returns to her farm and checks in with Fortune, then goes to her sick nephew Tommy.
events.quote: Tommy is in bed when she walks in his room, awake and staring out the window.

events.summary: Annie gives Tommy blue smoke for his pain, and keeps watch by his bed all night.
events.quote: "Here." She holds the bottle under his nose and uncorks it

events.summary: Annie finds a picnic basket on her stoop that appeared overnight without her hearing anyone.
events.quote: There's a basket waiting on her stoop that sure as sin wasn't there the night before

events.summary: Jody denies leaving the basket and tells Annie the townspeople are worried about her.
events.quote: "People 'round here are worried about y'all, out there all alone."

events.summary: A giant rattlewurm slithers through Saddlebrush, sending townspeople fleeing, then leaves without hurting anyone.
events.quote: an enormous rattlewurm slithers through the streets of Saddlebrush.

events.summary: The rattlewurm envenoms Mira, and Annie gives her blue smoke.
events.quote: Annie hardly knows what she's doing before she's doing it

events.summary: Annie volunteers to kill the rattlewurm and Bo offers to come along; she sets out at dawn the next day.
Annie tells Tommy she is leaving to hunt the rattlewurm, and he refuses medicine, saying he is tired all the time.
Tommy appears with a walking stick and tells Bo to bring his aunt back.
events.quote: "You come back with my aunt. Or you don't come back. You hear me?"

events.summary: Annie uses her enhanced vision to find the rattlewurm's lair and sees a baby rattlewurm joining it.
events.quote: another rattlewurm emerges. This one is considerably smaller.

events.summary: Annie decides not to slaughter the rattlewurms, and instead corrals them deeper into the dunes, which the townsfolk accept.
events.quote: for corralling them deeper into the dunes where prey was more plentiful and people scarcer

events.summary: Tommy tells Annie he is leaving for home and real medicine, with arrangements made through Jody.
Tommy embraces Annie, calling her Haseya, and tells her he loves her before leaving.
events.quote: I couldn't hate you. I love you.

events.summary: Annie concludes that she can build a community but will still be alone with her ghosts at night.
events.quote: it's always gonna be Annie Flash and her ghosts.

relations.quote: Her nephew does a whole lot of not looking at her these days.
She's my sister—I, I have to help.
In many ways, Fortune is her only companion.

relations.note: Akul put Tommy's life at risk because of Annie's misstep.
relations.quote: the vicious Hellspur leader who put Tommy's life on the line because of Annie's misstep

relations.note: A smaller rattlewurm is the large one's child.
